title: Go-Global | Cutout Pro Leads China AI Apps Abroad at 14.13M Monthly Visits; Toolify +43.52%
summary: Among China-origin AI products going global, Cutout Pro leads at 14.13M visits — strong pull in image enhancement. Fotor follows at 13.71M despite −8.70% MoM.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Go-global traffic · March 19, 2024

Among China-origin AI products going global, Cutout Pro leads at 14.13M visits — strong pull in image enhancement. Fotor follows at 13.71M despite −8.70% MoM.

Category highlights (Unique Research)

  • Audio/video: Vocal Remover 8.06M; Opus Clip AI 5.13M — both soft MoM but still active
  • Navigation: Toolify 3.94M visits, +43.52% MoM — convenience of AI-tool discovery
  • Personal chat/assistants: TheB.AI 0.99M (−30.36%); Talkie 0.21M (+32.39%)
  • Image/design: PixAI.Art UV 1.93M / visits 7.85M (−1.85%); SeaArt.AI UV 2.42M / visits 7.81M (+18.17%)
  • Video edit: Filmora UV 1.82M / visits 2.70M (−15.60%); Vizard UV 0.61M / visits 1.47M (−14.75%)

China AI go-global mixes product innovation and localization. Toolify’s jump and chat-assistant volatility both show how quickly overseas demand rotates. Unique Research: Chinese AI firms are rising in count and quality — more influence ahead as tech and partnerships deepen.

3 CN images/charts; attach on ingest.

— END —
